title: Preserve terminal worker evidence during metadata enrichment
summary: Remediate AUDIT-FIND-W01-008 by making CSV rerun coordinator-metadata enrichment preserve validated local_worker_result.v1 evidence and its terminal success semantics.
reason: The provider currently truncates and rewrites the authoritative worker-result artifact in place; a partial write can destroy proven success and project an already completed job as retryable failed_result_invalid.
affected_areas: generated source summaries and change-control evidence
behavior_before: Optional coordinator-metadata enrichment overwrites terminal worker evidence non-atomically and any enrichment failure discards the validated result as retryable invalid evidence.
behavior_after: Validated terminal evidence remains byte-for-byte intact unless a complete atomic enrichment replacement succeeds, and optional enrichment failure is surfaced separately without converting proven success into retryable work.
tests_added: atomic replace failure preserves original evidence and cleans temporary state
optional enrichment failure retains successful non-retryable done projection
partial temporary-write failure preserves original terminal evidence bytes
restart recovery ignores interrupted enrichment temporary files

rollback_plan: Revert only this packet's enrichment transaction/error-policy changes, focused tests, and generated artifacts. No persisted schema migration is required; orphaned temporary files use a non-authoritative suffix and are ignored by readers.
notes:
All validation uses synthetic temporary local_worker_result.v1 files and fake handoff paths. No representative real-media validation is required for this write-transaction defect, and no source/output/scratch media will be read or mutated. Python impact: existing network lifecycle provider and focused tests only; no new compatibility surface.
Atomic enrichment reuses the existing desktop network worker-state atomic writer; failed optional persistence is logged and included inside the existing worker_result_artifact contract, without adding dispatcher keyword arguments.
Representative real-media validation was not required by the finding because the defect is isolated to synthetic terminal-evidence metadata persistence; source/output/scratch media policy is unchanged.
Both edited Python paths already contained completed MP-CHANGE-2026-0722-017 inline-artifact work, and the provider also contained MP-CHANGE-2026-0722-019 active-claim affinity work. Those overlapping edits were preserved and remain owned by their existing packets.
